# The Doll Scout

Independent collectible-toy guides and free collection tools. Focus: Labubu / THE MONSTERS, SKULLPANDA, Jellycat and Sonny Angel. Not a toy seller or official authentication service. No live stock, popularity, resale-price or investment-return claims.

- [Collectible toy guides & free collection tools](https://thedollscout.com/) (en): Explore Labubu, SKULLPANDA, Jellycat and Sonny Angel. Choose a series, understand what you are buying and make room for the pieces you love.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Blind boxes & plush](https://thedollscout.com/brands/labubu) (en): Start with the exact series and format. THE MONSTERS figures, vinyl plush and pendants are different products.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — Designer figures & pendants](https://thedollscout.com/brands/skullpanda) (en): Explore the design, then check the format. A figure series and a plush pendant series need separate size and contents checks.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — Plush & gifts](https://thedollscout.com/brands/jellycat) (en): Choose a character, size and use. The same name can appear in several sizes, so compare the full product details before buying.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — Mini figures & blind boxes](https://thedollscout.com/brands/sonny-angel) (en): Find the series you like, then use the official regional store and retailer directory to check where you buy.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [Sammelfiguren: Ratgeber und kostenlose Werkzeuge](https://thedollscout.com/de/) (de): Labubu, SKULLPANDA, Jellycat und Sonny Angel entdecken. Serie auswählen, den Kauf verstehen und Platz für die Lieblingsstücke schaffen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Blindboxen & Plüsch](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/labubu) (de): Zuerst Serie und Format bestimmen. Figuren, Vinyl-Plüsch und Anhänger von THE MONSTERS sind unterschiedliche Produkte.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — Designerfiguren & Anhänger](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/skullpanda) (de): Design entdecken, dann Format prüfen. Figurenserien und Plüschanhänger benötigen eigene Maß- und Lieferumfangsprüfungen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — Plüsch & Geschenke](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/jellycat) (de): Figur, Größe und Verwendungszweck auswählen. Derselbe Name kann mehrere Größen bezeichnen; vor dem Kauf alle Produktangaben vergleichen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — Mini-Figuren & Blindboxen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/sonny-angel) (de): Eine passende Serie wählen und anschließend den regionalen Händler über das offizielle Verzeichnis prüfen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [潮玩收藏指南与免费收藏工具](https://thedollscout.com/zh/) (zh): 探索 Labubu、SKULLPANDA、Jellycat 与 Sonny Angel。挑选系列、读懂购买规则，也为喜欢的收藏留好位置。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — 盲盒与毛绒](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/labubu) (zh): 先确认具体系列和形态。THE MONSTERS 的手办、搪胶毛绒和挂件是不同产品。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — 设计师手办与挂件](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/skullpanda) (zh): 先选喜欢的设计，再核对产品形态。手办系列和毛绒挂件需要分别确认尺寸与包装内容。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — 毛绒与礼物](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/jellycat) (zh): 按角色、尺寸和用途选择。同一个名字可能有多个尺寸，购买前需要核对完整产品信息。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — 迷你公仔与盲盒](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/sonny-angel) (zh): 先找到喜欢的系列，再通过官方分地区店铺及零售商目录核对购买渠道。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [Collector tools for AI assistants](https://thedollscout.com/for-agents) (en): Find, read and call TDS collecting tools from an MCP-compatible assistant.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/for-agents.txt
- [Sammelwerkzeuge für KI-Assistenten](https://thedollscout.com/de/for-agents) (de): TDS-Sammelwerkzeuge mit einem MCP-kompatiblen Assistenten finden, lesen und aufrufen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/for-agents.txt
- [供 AI 助手使用的收藏工具](https://thedollscout.com/zh/for-agents) (zh): 通过兼容 MCP 的助手发现、读取和调用 TDS 收藏工具。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/for-agents.txt

## Existing collecting tools

- [Labubu regular-style and secret probability calculator](https://thedollscout.com/brands/labubu#style-probability) — EN/DE/ZH; editable independent-draw models, also callable with MCP calculate_style_probability.
- [Selected creator videos](https://thedollscout.com/#watch) — creator attribution, original links and related tool actions.
- [Labubu odds reference and calculator](https://thedollscout.com/rarity)
- [Collection tracker](https://thedollscout.com/collection-tracker)
- [Display fit calculator](https://thedollscout.com/display-calculator)
- [Collection ledger](https://thedollscout.com/workbench/collectorledger)
- [Collector data and MCP](https://thedollscout.com/data/)
